findings.detail: Operator must verify Fast Boot is Off for USB install media
VMD/RAID can hide NVMe from Win11 setup — prefer AHCI if install fails
USB storage must be above internal disk for rescue/install stick
No BitLocker hint in runtime discovery

operator_next_actions: BIOS: Secure Boot aktivieren (Win11-Setup erfordert oft Secure Boot)
BIOS: Fast Boot = Disabled beim USB-Install
BIOS: VMD/RAID prüfen — bei fehlender Systemdisk AHCI/Non-RAID
BIOS: Boot Order — USB Stick vor interner NVMe
